dedupe_keys.name: xbat battery waste image post processing script

description: The XBAT+ team publishes a Python image post-processing script for its battery-waste detection dataset. The Zenodo description says it pads non-square RGB and X-ray images to square dimensions and resizes them to the training and test format. The code is archived as one ZIP and is publicly accessible under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Coverage follows images from the project's optical camera and X-ray scanner, not arbitrary recycling lines. The tool can prepare consistent computer-vision inputs before evaluating robotic sorting or recycling-facility simulation. A caveat is that resizing changes pixel scale and cannot correct wrong device labels or imaging artifacts. The metadata do not expose all script options or dependencies, so direct transfer to another camera is unverified. Own metadata and manifest were checked without downloading or executing the archive. The annotated XBAT+ images are a separate resource; no related catalogue platform was identified.
